definitions:
def walk : Nat → Int → Int → Int × Int
  | 0, a, b => (a,b)
  | n+1, a, b => walk n (a+2) (b+1)
goal: (walk n a b).1 - 2 * (walk n a b).2 = a - 2*b ∧ b ≤ (walk n a b).2

definitions:
def revAcc : List Nat → List Nat → List Nat
  | [], ys => ys
  | x::xs, ys => revAcc xs (x::ys)

inductive Tree where
  | leaf : Nat → Tree
  | fork : Tree → Tree → Tree

def flatten : Tree → List Nat
  | .leaf x => [x]
  | .fork l r => flatten l ++ flatten r

def mirror : Tree → Tree
  | .leaf x => .leaf x
  | .fork l r => .fork (mirror r) (mirror l)

def treeAcc : Tree → List Nat → List Nat
  | .leaf x, acc => x::acc
  | .fork l r, acc => treeAcc l (treeAcc r acc)

def splitPairs : List Nat → List Nat × List Nat
  | [] => ([], [])
  | [x] => ([x], [])
  | x::y::xs => (x::(splitPairs xs).1, y::(splitPairs xs).2)
def weave : List Nat → List Nat → List Nat
  | [], ys => ys
  | x::xs, [] => x::xs
  | x::xs, y::ys => x::y::weave xs ys
